race.comment: LADY MILAN (3) has hit a purple patch of late with a win and four placings from her past five outings. Has a win and two placings from three spins around this circuit and it's hard to knock mares in form. Looks the one they all have to run down. MISS ZERMATT (6) was a touch disappointing last time out but the form prior was full of merit. Gets 3kg off and is worth another chance. MERCATELLO (4) has been well in the betting in all five career efforts to date and where there's smoke there's fire. Keep very safe. EXTREME ALLY (8) strips fitter second-up from the spell and gets the services of Thompson in the saddle. In the mix on best figures. DEEP KHARMA (2) next best with the claim from the low draw.
